items.title: Complete manage-sense run
items.instructions: Use the correct past-perfect form of run in the manage or organize sense.

payload.stimulus: Before the club meeting began, Duyen ___ two school events.
payload.explanation: Had run marks Duyen's organizing experience as earlier than the later club meeting, and run means organized here.
payload.spelling_policy: Require the two-word form had run.

items.title: Construct a linked phrase
items.instructions: Use every element to form a sentence with the indicated connected-speech boundary.

payload.target_structure: past perfect with marked consonant-to-vowel link
payload.primary_answer: Lan had run_an event before noon.
acceptable_variants: Lan had run_an event before noon.
payload.scoring_guidance: Require had run and preserve run_an as the marked practice boundary.

items.title: Read the management timeline
items.instructions: Read the account and explain which organized activity happened first.

payload.stimulus: At 7:00, members arrived for the science club. Earlier, Priya had run a workshop for new volunteers.

questions.text: What had Priya organized before the members arrived?

items.title: Retell prior experience
items.instructions: Explain how an earlier organized event prepared someone for a later club meeting.

payload.communicative_goal: Retell an earlier management experience and its later benefit.
constraints: Use had run in the manage sense.
Include one consonant-to-vowel link you can mark in your script.
payload.expected_output: A clear two-stage account followed by the result or benefit.

rubric.criterion: Run unmistakably means organize or manage.
The marked link joins a final consonant to a following vowel without deleting either sound.

items.title: Translate organized an event
items.instructions: Translate the Vietnamese sentence into English to show an event completed before the meeting began.

payload.source_text: Trước khi cuộc họp bắt đầu, cô ấy đã tổ chức một sự kiện ở trường.
payload.intended_meaning: She organized a school event before the later meeting began.
payload.primary_answer: Before the meeting began, she had run an event at school.
acceptable_variants: Before the meeting began, she had run a school event.
payload.scoring_guidance: Require a clear later past reference and had run in the manage meaning.
